definitions.explanation: The processing of calculations in a computer, including arithmetic, logical, and numerical operations performed by the CPU or GPU. A technical term used in hardware specifications and programming.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧CPU⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{演算処理|えんざんしょり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧。
⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧な{演算処理|えんざんしょり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧GPU⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: GPUs are used for complex computations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{高速|こうそく}→高速：02749_kousoku⟧な{演算処理|えんざんしょり}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Handling large volumes of data requires high-speed computational power.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{演算|えんざん}→演算：05150_enzan⟧ (calculation, operation) and ⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧ (processing, handling). Usually refers to numerical or logical operations inside a computer, as opposed to input/output or data transfer. Common in discussions of CPUs, GPUs, and algorithm performance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演算処理|えんざんしょり}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧: computing power
- {演算処理|えんざんしょり}{速度|そくど}: processing speed
- ⟦{並列|へいれつ}→並列：08417_heiretsu⟧{演算処理|えんざんしょり}: parallel processing
- ⟦{高速|こうそく}→高速：02749_kousoku⟧{演算処理|えんざんしょり}: high-speed computation

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{演算|えんざん}→演算：05150_enzan⟧: operation; calculation — the underlying act being processed
- ⟦{処理|しょり}{能力|のうりょく}→処理能力：18415_shorinouryoku⟧: processing capacity — a broader term that also covers I/O and data handling
- CPU: central processing unit — the primary chip carrying out {演算処理|えんざんしょり}
- GPU: graphics processing unit — specialized for massive parallel {演算処理|えんざんしょり}
